serviceIdentification.serviceDescription:
eGain Suite is delivered as a SaaS offering using a multi-tenant Government Community Cloud computing environment. It is available to federal, state, local, and tribal governments, as well as research institutions and government contractors.

eGain Suite helps agencies serve the public across digital and assisted channels from a single platform. Digital engagement services cover real-time chat, cobrowsing, email, webform and social inquiries, secure messaging, outbound notifications and targeted website offers. AI-powered knowledge management gives agents and the public consistent answers from a common knowledge base, through self-service, a virtual assistant that can hand off to a live agent, and a generative AI agent that asks clarifying questions and answers only from approved knowledge sources. Agents work from a unified desktop with case management for logging, tracking and resolving issues, and contact center analytics measure and manage interactions across channels.

trustCenter.repositoryDescription: The eGain Suite (FR2023601671) FedRAMP Certification Package is held in FedRAMP's secure repository and is released to agencies by the FedRAMP PMO.
trustCenter.accessRequestInstructions:
Federal agencies request access to the eGain Suite package (FedRAMP ID **FR2023601671**) from the FedRAMP PMO:

1. Download the [Agency Package Request Form](https://www.fedramp.gov/resources/documents/Agency_Package_Request_Form.pdf).
2. Complete the form, entering package ID FR2023601671.
3. Submit it to the FedRAMP PMO as the form directs.

The FedRAMP PMO grants access once the request is approved.

secureConfigurationGuidance.repositoryDescription: The eGain Suite Secure Configuration Guide is part of the eGain Suite (FR2023601671) FedRAMP Certification Package held in FedRAMP's secure repository.
secureConfigurationGuidance.accessRequestInstructions: The Secure Configuration Guide is included in the eGain Suite FedRAMP Certification Package (FedRAMP ID **FR2023601671**). Federal agencies request access from the FedRAMP PMO by completing the [Agency Package Request Form](https://www.fedramp.gov/resources/documents/Agency_Package_Request_Form.pdf) with package ID FR2023601671 and submitting it as the form directs.

certifiedServices.serviceDescription: eGain Chat is a real-time chat assistance to website visitors.
eGain Cobrowse allows agents to provide real-time assistance to customers. Agent can share and co-navigate HTML and JavaScript content via web browser with a customer to provide support.
eGain CallTrack is a case management solution for the resolution of customer issues with call taking, logging, and tracking capability.
eGain Mail+Social handles large volumes of email, webform, and social inquiries with automated routing, workflows. Letter and fax interactions are also handled in this service, with PDF-based output.
eGain Secure Messaging is a secure email messaging system that authenticates the customer before allowing the viewing of confidential information.
eGain Knowledge+AI is a knowledge management software including AI that provides agents and other users answers from a common knowledge base using AI technologies including generative AI.

eGain SelfService+AI provides self-service experiences that enable customer self-service and enables context-aware escalations to live customer service agents if required by the customer. This service also uses eGain Knowledge+AI for delivery of article information.

eGain Virtual Assistant is a virtual agent providing a way for users to get answers and assistance on an organization’s website. A user chats with the virtual assistant (also called virtual agent or chatbot). The chatbot provides answers to any queries input within the chatbot.

eGain AI Agent is an interactive generative AI tool using chatbot capability. It will provide answers (on approved knowledge sources) and present them inside the chatbot to the user/agent. It will ask clarification questions to ensure it provides the right answers and context to the user/agent.
eGain Notify, enables outbound notification messages to customers.
eGain Offers uses browsing behavior and other attributes, to proactively serve a targeted offer to website visitors.
eGain Contact Center Analytics is an analytics tool to measure, manage, interactions within contact centers with customers.
eGain Advisor Desktop is a desktop for contact center agents.

certified.useCase: AWS GovCloud (US) hosts the eGain Suite infrastructure (compute, storage, networking).
Microsoft Azure Government provides Azure OpenAI Service for the generative AI capabilities in eGain Knowledge+AI and eGain AI Agent, and provides authentication services for eGain Suite.
Zscaler Private Access - Government provides zero-trust administrative access to backend applications.
